panels.title: Recovery codes used in the range
panels.description: An admin signed in with a recovery code instead of their authenticator. Expect zero; confirm each one with the admin.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as "recovery codes used" from audit_log where action = 'auth.recovery_code.used' and $__timeFilter(ts)
select $__timeGroupAlias(ts, '1d', 0), count(*) as "sign-ins" from audit_log where action = 'auth.login.admin' and $__timeFilter(ts) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Credential and account changes per day, by kind

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(l.ts, '1d', 0), k.label as metric, count(*) as events from audit_log l join (values ('auth.login.admin', 'admin sign-in'), ('auth.recovery_code.used', 'recovery code used'), ('admin.user.totp_reset', '2FA reset'), ('user.revoke_sessions', 'sessions revoked'), ('auth.password.reset', 'password reset'), ('auth.password.change', 'password changed'), ('account.email.changed', 'email changed'), ('account.deleted', 'account deleted'), ('user.set_role', 'role changed')) as k (action, label) on k.action = l.action where l.action <> 'auth.login.admin' and $__timeFilter(l.ts) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Last 50 security events in the range
panels.description: audit_log.meta is never shown: it can hold an IP or an email, and grafana_ro can't read it.

targets.rawSql: select l.ts as time, k.label as event, coalesce(actor.username, case when l.action = 'account.deleted' then '(the deleted player)' else '(none: command line or since deleted)' end) as actor, coalesce(target.username, l.target_type) as target from audit_log l join (values ('auth.login.admin', 'admin sign-in'), ('auth.recovery_code.used', 'recovery code used'), ('admin.user.totp_reset', '2FA reset'), ('user.revoke_sessions', 'sessions revoked'), ('auth.password.reset', 'password reset'), ('auth.password.change', 'password changed'), ('account.email.changed', 'email changed'), ('account.deleted', 'account deleted'), ('user.set_role', 'role changed')) as k (action, label) on k.action = l.action left join users actor on actor.id = l.actor_id left join users target on l.target_type = 'user' and target.id::text = l.target_id where $__timeFilter(l.ts) order by l.ts desc limit 50
